title: Join us next week at LAB AI Demo Day
summary: Join us next week at LAB AI Demo Day
body_markdown:
We’ve been hard at work with our agent builder partners helping to shape the future of[LiveRamp’s data collaboration network](https://liveramp.com/) , and of agentic marketing, broadly. As we’ve accelerated marketers’ ability to roll out AI-powered planning, measurement, activation, and data transformation in conjunction with our partners, we’ve secured promising wins that bring to life how AI exponentially boosts the performance of data collaboration.


Now, as the ecosystem gathers at[Advertising Week New York](https://advertisingweek.com/awnewyork-2026/) , we’re excited to celebrate everything that our[LiveRamp Agent Builder (LAB)](https://liveramp.com/news/liveramp-launches-agentic-partner-program-to-fast-track-agentic-deployments-for-customers) program has accomplished since launching only a short time ago at Cannes, and to showcase how marketers can further maximize their gains using agents on our network.


Our first-ever LAB Demo Day on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 will be an opportunity to experience AI agents running real marketing workflows, discuss how they can be applied to your specific business, and leave with clear next steps for your projects. Attendees can watch varied demos from different parts of the ecosystem, chat 1:1 with partners, or connect with our team to discuss how to enhance your growth with LiveRamp-powered agents.


Our LAB Founding partners will be there, including two new Builders that we are excited to welecome to the program:


- [Akkio](https://www.akkio.com/) **,** which enables media teams to move from audience discovery through analysis, segment creation, and activation, all in a single agentic workflow.
- [Datalinx](https://www.datalinx.ai/) **,** which automates the standardization, mapping, and maintenance of client first-party data and taxonomies for use across LiveRamp products.
- [Dstillery](https://dstillery.com/) **,** whose agentic platform, DS-1, boosts end-to-end media buying workflows, from planning and insights to custom modeling, activation, and in-flight optimization.
- [Galatiq](https://galatiq.ai/) **,** a team of forward-deployed AI engineers powered by SpaceXAI that builds custom agentic solutions, helping marketers unlock the full power of their data.
- [Newton Research](https://www.newtonresearch.ai/) **,** which deploys intelligent agents[to unlock unlimited analytics](https://liveramp.com/customer-stories/newton-research) and media optimization across data environments, including LiveRamp’s Cross-Media Intelligence. Newton will also highlight how its agents have improved data analysis for Hill’s Pet Nutrition, helping the brand drive better performance.
- [SemantIQ](https://www.semantiqhealth.com/) **,** which enables health and life sciences marketers to use AI-native workflows within the[LiveRamp Clean Room](https://liveramp.com/our-platform/clean-rooms) to build, analyze, and activate healthcare provider audiences and generate faster media intelligence. SemantIQ will also highlight how its agent has been deployed to Klick Health’s programmatic activation and planning teams.


Learn more about LAB Demo Day and[request to attend](https://events.liveramp.com/LiveRamp_AI_Demo_Day) .


We look forward to seeing you there.
